# BCGov Crow - v0.17.2

## Release type

Patch release: clearer C# unit and integration test authoring guidance.

## Summary

Adds practical guidance for writing analyzer-aware C# tests, fixtures, and test helpers without imposing
repository-wide coding rules or requiring analyzer configuration.

## Highlights

- Crow Testing now routes .NET unit and integration test work to focused C# guidance on xUnit theory data,
  skip behavior, async cancellation, fixture disposal, logging, dates, and other recurring analyzer findings.
- Guidance is scoped to test code. Existing project conventions and `.editorconfig` settings can be followed
  when present; projects without them are not asked to adopt new repository-wide rules.
- Microsoft Roslyn, xUnit, and Sonar rule IDs are included as references to explain the practices, not as a
  requirement to enable every analyzer.

## Changes

- Added narrative guidance organized around test data, async tests and fixtures, and readable test code.
- Routed .NET unit tests, SQL Server integration tests, the testing workflow, and the Crow Testing Agent to
  the test-specific guidance.
- Clarified xUnit v2/v3 differences and corrected rule references for `S1994` and blocking async calls.
- Kept analyzer recommendations scoped to test code; no repository-wide analyzer settings are added or
  changed.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.17.2 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.17.2.zip --global --target copilot
```
